Project.title: ProjectItem
Project.description: Showcase items posted by lab admin across Collaborations, Launches, and Docs

projectId.description: Identifier like CLB-01, LNCH-01, or DOC-01

title.description: Title of the project, collaboration, or document

status.description: Launch Stage: Projected, In Dev, Beta, Published (primarily for launches)

readme.description: Rich GitHub-style Markdown documentation or paper text

clientName.description: Company, organization, or club name for collaborations

clientRole.description: Role or contribution context for collaborations

docType.description: Document type: Research Paper, Technical Spec, Whitepaper, RFC, etc.

docReadingTime.description: Estimated reading duration or page count

docDate.description: Date or version of the document

docContext.description: Context details, research domain, or methodology summary

externalUrl.description: External publication link, PDF link, or preprint

liveUrl.description: Live production, client demo, or deployed documentation URL

published.description: Whether item is visible to public

isRestricted.description: If true, card is visible to public but specifications and details are redacted; admin can view full details

isClassified.description: If true, completely hidden from public (does not exist to non-admin); only visible to admin

icon.description: Optional custom shaped icon/emblem for the item

/projects/{projectId}.description: Collection of software launches, collaborations/clients, and research docs
